quarterly_data.signal: HPE's 10-K names Broadcom and others as single-source suppliers of industry-standard Application-Specific Standard Products used in HPE products, noting these suppliers are also single-source suppliers for the entire market. HPE uses original and outsourced design manufacturers and outsourced contract manufacturers to design and build HPE-branded products, ordinarily acquires materials and components through blanket and scheduled purchase orders covering demand for periods averaging 90 to 120 days, and also acquires component inventory in anticipation of supply constraints or enters longer-term pricing commitments with vendors to improve priority, price and availability of supply.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase orders cover periods averaging 90 to 120 days

quarterly_data.signal: HPE's 10-K: AI systems demand, amid persisting data center space availability constraints, continued to drive significant AI backlog, while demand across the AI portfolio stayed uneven because of lumpy deals. The supply and demand environment for GPUs remains uneven as the market transitions to next-generation GPUs, which left HPE's inventory levels elevated at times during fiscal 2025.
